name: pimento
title: Pimento
description: Activate and deactivate your Azure PIM roles and presets with the pimento CLI.
author: melvin2306

commands.name: roles
commands.title: Search PIM Roles
commands.subtitle: Pimento
commands.description: Your eligible Azure PIM roles with their status: activate (justification and duration) or deactivate them.

commands.name: presets
commands.title: Activate PIM Preset
commands.subtitle: Pimento
commands.description: Your saved Pimento presets: activate one.

commands.name: active
commands.title: Active PIM Roles
commands.subtitle: Pimento
commands.description: The roles that are active now, with the time left.

preferences.name: pimentoPath
preferences.title: pimento Path
preferences.description: The pimento CLI to run. Empty: ~/.local/bin/pimento, then PATH (and Homebrew), then /Applications/Pimento.app/Contents/Helpers/pimento.

preferences.name: tenant
preferences.title: Tenant
preferences.description: Tenant GUID or domain (pimento --tenant). Empty: $PIMENTO_TENANT, then the az or Pimento sign-in's tenant.

preferences.name: demoMode
preferences.title: Demo Mode
preferences.label: Use demo data (pimento --demo)
preferences.description: A simulated Azure with synthetic data: offline, nothing is sent, none of your files are used.

scripts.prepublishOnly: echo 'This extension is not published to npm or the Raycast Store; see README.md.' && exit 1
